title: VBR resultant force in the relaxed all-fours position (absolute), per patient

quantity.name: resultant force on VBR
quantity.definition: ABSOLUTE average resultant VBR force in the relaxed all-fours position (kneeling on hands and knees).

source.authors: Rohlmann A, Schwachmeyer V, Graichen F, Bergmann G
source.sample: 5 patients (4 M, 1 F) with telemeterised VBR (WP1-WP4 at L1, WP5 at L3); 3-5 patients per exercise; in vivo; A3 compression fracture; posterior internal fixator (2 segments in 3 patients, 4 segments in WP3 and WP4) + telemeterised VBR; measurements few days to 65 months post-op

protocol.summary: Relaxed all-fours position before the all-fours exercises.
how_to_simulate: Model the patient kneeling on hands and knees, spine neutral, relaxed
Output resultant force at the implant level (L1; L3 for WP5)
A whole-spine MSK model outputs total segment compression at the implant level, not the implant share; compare trends/relative changes unless the model includes the VBR and posterior fixator

subject_model.implant_note: VBR replaces parts of the fractured vertebral body and the adjacent discs; posterior internal fixator remains in situ
subject_model.source: Rohlmann 2014c gives only group ranges (4 M/1 F, 62-71 y, 60-74 kg, 168-180 cm, BMI 19-26, L1 in WP1-WP4, L3 in WP5); per-patient values taken from the same WP1-WP5 cohort tables (Rohlmann 2014a Table 1 / Dreischarf 2015 Table 1)

protocol.notes: Load measured on a telemeterised vertebral body replacement (modified Synex, 6 load components, accuracy ~2% force / 5% moment of 3000 N / 20 Nm calibration range) that shares the load with the posterior internal fixator, residual vertebral bone and bone graft; the VBR force is NOT the total spinal load. Evaluation: peak resultant force during the exercise minus the mean resultant force in the relaxed resting position (same posture) = force increase. Per patient: median and range over trials; "Average" bar = median of the patient medians with range of the medians. Lying resultant VBR force was usually <50 N (up to 100 N with muscle tension). Only general instructions were given; trials span ~5 years post-op.

extraction.from: text Results (Exercises in the all-fours position)
extraction.check_notes: Double-check (msk_invivo lead): every number in data[] was found in the pdftotext output of the source table (minus signs rendered as "2" or "–" in the PDF text layer; trailing zeros dropped, e.g. -3.280 -> -3.28); sign of several values confirmed against the table text. | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Results text: 81/169/74/121 N for WP1/WP2/WP4/WP5)

pass_rule.rule: model within +-50 N of patient value (if VBR load sharing modelled)
